name: Accordion
title: Accordion
description: A set of collapsible panels with headings.

files.content:
{#snippet content()} {#if items.length} {#each items as item, index} {item.title}
{item.content}

<script lang="ts">
import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

<AccordionPrimitive.Item
